What a failure's `data` holds: its Error code, whether the same call may
succeed when made again, and the code's own details.

retryable.description: Whether the same call may succeed when made again.

code.description:
One of JSON-RPC's predefined codes for a protocol failure; otherwise
the numeric class of the Error code's group, from −32000 to −32099.

message.description: What went wrong, for people; never matched on.

ErrorResponse.description: The reply to a call that failed.

Evidence.description: What a test saw, beside its checks.

messages.description:
The scripted messages exchanged, for a Client conformance case (ADR

observations.description:
What the Proving ground observed on the server side, as it reported

Executable.description:
The executable a Journey variant drove: its Product and the Product

host's must name (ADR 0095).

HttpsUrl.description: An https:// URL with a host.

Journey.description:
One Journey: a goal a person reaches through its Product's public
surfaces, written as steps from a starting state to an outcome checked
from outside the engine (ADR 0063).

area.description: The number of the ADR 0037 area whose spec owns the Journey.

covers.description:
The Feature IDs the Journey exercises, each `<kind>:<id>`, such as
`row:CO-18` for a row of ADR 0037's matrix or `story:3-18` for a user
story.

goal.description:
What the person achieves and what MUST be true at the end, in RFC
2119 words, readable as a specification without the code. It never
changes under the Journey's ID.

id.description: `J-` and three to nine digits, equal to the file's name.

product.description:
The Product whose executable and SDK packages the Journey drives:
Collie when Collie carries every step, Foxhound otherwise (ADR 0094).

proving_ground.description:
The Proving ground data the Journey starts from; absent when its goal
touches no page.

reason.description: Why a retired Journey was retired.

replaced_by.description: The Journeys that hold a retired Journey's goal now, possibly none.

status.description: Whether the Journey is still run.

steps.description: The steps, in order, in declarative words.

surfaces.description:
Each surface the goal is reachable on, by its name in ADR 0063, with
the milestone by which that surface must prove it.

title.description: A short name in the glossary's terms.

next.description:
The next free Journey number: a new Journey takes it and increments
it in the same pull request, and every ID is below it.

JourneyDocument.description:
A `journey` document: one Journey variant's outcome, derived from its
steps, checks and oracle answers.

checks.description: Each check of the Journey's outcome, in its order.

proving_ground.description:
The Proving ground it started, for a Journey whose goal touches a
page.

steps.description: Each step of the Journey, in its order.

surface.description:
The variant's surface, by its name in ADR 0063, or `foxhound-cli`
for a Collie Journey's `cli` variant run on Foxhound's executable
(ADR 0094).

surface_package.description:
The surface's package, for a surface that has one (an SDK, the
Console's build, an adapter).

tasks.description: Each Proving ground task the Journey names.

JourneyId.description: A Journey's ID: `J-` and three to nine digits (ADR 0063).

JourneyOutcome.description:
A Journey variant's outcome. A declared variant with no document is
`unproved`, which the catalog report computes from the document's
absence (ADR 0063).

Every automated step and check passed and every named task is
`verified`.
Anything else.
It runs.

engine or exhausted resources.

anyOf.description: A message that expects no reply.

oneOf.description: The first milestone.
The second milestone.
The third milestone.
The fourth milestone.

An oracle's answer for one Proving ground task: the task, the outcome,
and the rest of the Proving ground's answer as it came (what is missing,
extra or wrong, the tool's status, the oracle's time).

OracleOutcome.description:
The outcome the Proving ground's oracle gives a submitted result, whatever
status the tool reported (ADR 0025).

oneOf.description: Correct and complete.
Correct but missing Records, without claiming success.
Claimed success with wrong or missing data.
Neither correct nor a claimed success.
Every declared case ran and passed.
No case failed, but not every one ran, or none is declared.
A case failed.
